censored: A censored p99 ranks after every uncensored p99. Censored candidates rank by median completion, then median batch CPU.
tie: A feasible candidate ties the best when its repeat range overlaps the best's range on the ranking metric.

comparability.schedule_digest: identical across every branch of a unit

note: objective-v1 with two changes from the jobs-v1 pilot. The speed gate also covers the pre-decision window, measured as batch units times their nominal time against batch CPU time; a branch that passed the horizon gate had run 12.9% fast during its prefix. The pending spread follows from that gate: at the lowest jobs-v2 overload, 64.8%, a 5% prefix speed band moves the backlog by up to about 22% either way, so two admissible branches can differ by about 44% of the median. The label rule itself is unchanged: feasibility is relative to the balanced branch of the same unit, batch is guest CPU time over the horizon, and overlapping repeat ranges tie.
